title: Longer-Round Differential and Linear Bounds for DEFAULT
summary: Existing computations provide differential-probability and linear-bias bounds for DEFAULT only over a limited round range; extending them to additional rounds remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine differential-probability and linear-bias bounds for $\mathrm{DEFAULT}$ at round counts beyond the currently computed range, using automated modelling or computation that overcomes the solver-time limitation of the existing modelling and computing resources.

scope.domain: Automated differential and linear cryptanalysis of the DEFAULT block cipher.
parameters: Round count: specifies the cipher depth for which differential-probability and linear-bias bounds are sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the bounds to round counts beyond the currently computed range while overcoming the solver-time limitation of the existing modelling and computing resources.

citations.label: DEFAULT: Cipher Level Resistance Against Differential Fault Attack

progress.summary: The paper reports the computed bounds in Table 6 and says extending them is difficult because of solver time under its current modelling and computing resources.
